summaryZh: Sheikh 实验室研究心肌生物力学应激反应通路，重点是细胞间连接复合体突变导致的致心律失常性右室心肌病。团队使用基因工程小鼠、患者 iPSC、微型生理检测、酵母双杂交和共培养等模型，探索连接网络对心脏功能的作用。
researchQuestions: 哪些通路驱动心肌的生物力学应激反应？
topics: 致心律失常性右室心肌病

evidence.quote: The Sheikh Lab focuses on better understanding the pathways driving biomechanical stress responses in cardiac muscle

The lab exploits genetically engineered mouse models, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) from human patients, miniaturized physiological assays, yeast-two-hybrid screens, aligned cardiomyocyte mouse models, co-culture devices
The Sheikh Lab focuses on better understanding the pathways driving biomechanical stress responses in cardiac muscle as they are major triggers for human genetic-based cardiac diseases.
